basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old software engineer originally from Richmond, Virginia. I have a keen interest in urban development and community planning, which is why I frequent the r/rva subreddit. My hobbies include anime, which explains my visits to niche subreddits, and I enjoy uncovering leaks and behind-the-scenes content related to my favorite shows. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility that comes with living a childfree lifestyle. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 9 PM, as I work a standard 9-to-5 job.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a computer science degree from Virginia Tech, which sparked my love for technology and software. Over the years, I've honed my skills through work on various projects and continuous self-learning, particularly in urban tech solutions. My interest in community planning led me to engage in discussions on platforms like Reddit.
